sentences.text: If the delay in releasing the original property documents is attributable to the UCB, the bank must compensate the borrower at ₹5,000 for each day of delay beyond 30 days after full repayment or settlement of the loan account.
The UCB rules also require the bank to release the original movable or immovable property documents and remove charges within 30 days after full repayment or settlement.

The evidence does not show any rule finding that changes this amount for this case, and the other delay-compensation provisions in the record concern different contexts such as safe deposit locker / articles in safe custody or pledged collateral.
